module.name: Media Substrate Model
module.purpose: Describes the structural physics of media ecosystems through a five-axis vector substrate [S, D, A, N, T] — defining invariants, attractor basins, behavioral modes, and adapter integration for substrate-level media analysis parallel to the Governance Substrate Model.

submodules.name: Analyzer
submodules.purpose: MSM Analyzer engine mirroring the GSM Analyzer — substrate-level analysis, basin detection, mode classification, and drift measurement.
